subject.title: fix(telegram): surface diagnostic warning when inline keyboard buttons silently dropped due to 64-byte callback_data limit

question: Should an over-limit Telegram callback remain an ok:true text-only delivery with an operator warning, or must the message caller receive a structured degradation or failure?
rationale: The linked issue concerns safety-gated workflows where log-only visibility does not let the calling agent detect lost approval controls, so implementation correctness depends on the intended delivery contract.

options.title: Surface caller-visible degradation
options.body: Return a structured degraded or failed delivery result when requested buttons are dropped, while retaining the operator warning.

options.title: Keep log-only success
options.body: Preserve ok:true text-only delivery and treat the diagnostic warning as the complete product contract, with explicit tests and documentation.

recommendation.title: Surface caller-visible degradation
recommendation.body: Return a structured degraded or failed delivery result when requested buttons are dropped, while retaining the operator warning.

likelyOwner.reason: The current button-resolution and presentation-rendering history is predominantly theirs, making them the strongest available owner for the delivery-contract choice.
